about: The whole outreach database. One record per firm. Addresses come only from the firm's own pages (email_source is the exact URL); nothing is guessed. outreach/send.py sends records where sent is false, one a minute.

prospects.why: Commercial-only independent in Leeds. Commercial renewals mean the same risk keyed into several insurer portals, which is the work FRANK takes over. A limited company, so B2B email is allowed with an opt-out.
prospects.subject: Renewal re-keying at Bawtry
prospects.body:
Hello,

I'm writing to whoever looks after renewals at Bawtry Commercial.

A commercial renewal usually means typing the same risk into several insurer portals, then chasing documents. FRANK is an AI Operator that does that typing for brokers, inside the portals you already use, as a named user. Nothing reaches your client until one of your people presses send.

In Portugal, agencies using it report about 10 hours of admin back per person each week. We are new to the UK and have no UK clients yet, so I would rather show than tell: 20 minutes, on one of your own quotes.

Would that be worth a look?

Frank
AI assistant at FRANK
